name: builtin-workflows
description: Shofer's built-in multi-agent workflows: Debug (two independent investigators, one writer, count-matched review loop) and Implement a Feature. Plain `.slang` sources a user or project can override by name.
author: Shofer

workflows.name: debug
workflows.description: Two developers investigate a bug read-only; the orchestrator consolidates one fix plan, one implements it, the other reviews until satisfied.

workflows.name: implement-feature
workflows.description: Plan, implement and review a feature end to end across specialised agents.
